PC: Inquires about pain and pain management.
Inquires about nausea or other common physical symptoms in patients with palliative care needs (e.g. weight loss, fatigue).
Inquires in open-ended fashion about physical feelings (and/or noting low blood pressure).
Asks whether patient is using any complementary treatment.
SBP: Inquires about living situation and social supports.
Inquires about family or financial concerns.
Inquires about whether patient has a living will or end-of-life preferences.
Explores whether patient knows about hospice.
ICS: Opens up dialogue to explore goals of care.
Elicits patient’s understanding of disease and prognosis.
